name: S07 apparatus proposal

status_meaning.modelled: Present in the S07 numerical model with these dimensions and values
status_meaning.proposed: Needed to build the apparatus; not represented in any simulation yet

components.label: Cylindrical cell bore
components.spec: Inner diameter 8 mm, height 6 mm, axis vertical; rigid walls except the source surfaces

components.label: Three liquid layers
components.spec: Water 79.48 uL / NOA 61 (uncured) 123.10 uL / water 99.02 uL, bottom to top; NOA 61 sound speed is a placeholder

components.label: Pinned contact lines at z = -1 and +1 mm
components.spec: Model: fixed contact lines at the wall. Hardware (proposed): sharp circumferential edges or wetting steps that hold both contact lines

components.label: Window source surfaces (z = -3 and +3 mm)
components.spec: 32 concentric annular regions each, 0.125 mm pitch; ideal normal-velocity sources V.n = Y P + g with impedance-matched admittance; peak 0.345 / 0.146 m/s (73 / 31 nm displacement)

components.label: Wall source surface
components.spec: 48 axial bands of 0.125 mm (16 per layer), admittance factor 0.5; peak 0.107 m/s (23 nm displacement)

components.label: Drive command
components.spec: 0.75 MHz, 112 complex amplitudes from 20 continuous modes (design/source-commands.csv); 0.55 W source power, 0.37 MPa sampled peak pressure

components.label: Optical conjugates
components.spec: On-axis object at z = -101 mm, image plane at z = +151 mm, shared intermediate conjugate +201 mm, clear apertures 4 mm

components.label: Transparent ring-electrode transducers as windows
components.spec: Optically transparent piezoelectric plates with 32 transparent concentric ring electrodes each; transparency, electrode-gap diffraction and window refraction are not modelled; literature precedent to be confirmed

components.label: Segmented piezoelectric tube
components.spec: Tube forming the bore wall with 48 ring electrodes of 0.125 mm; inter-electrode coupling not modelled

components.label: Backing and matching layers
components.spec: Chosen so each emitting surface approximates the modelled impedance-matched admittance; requires acoustic calibration of g per channel

components.label: Fill and vent ports, syringe pumps
components.spec: Separate ports per layer; the meniscus moves about 40 um per uL of displaced volume, so dispensing alone cannot set it to 10 nm: final trim by closed-loop optical feedback

components.label: Temperature-controlled enclosure
components.spec: Peltier stage and thermistor around the cell. Thermal expansion of the 79.5 uL lower water layer alone moves the front face about 0.8 um/K (estimate, not modelled): about 10 mK stability or closed-loop correction needed; sound-speed sensitivity needs about 0.4 K

components.label: 112-channel phase-controlled transmitter
components.spec: Continuous-wave 0.75 MHz, independent amplitude and phase per channel, about 0.55 W acoustic in total

components.label: Point source
components.spec: Pinhole with LED on axis at z = -101 mm, in water-equivalent optical path (entrance window not modelled)

components.label: Image-plane sensor and wavefront sensor
components.spec: Camera at z = +151 mm for the spot; wavefront or interferometric shape measurement for closed-loop trim

components.label: Control computer
components.spec: Reads optics and temperature, updates the 112-channel command and fill trim; feedback law not designed

components.label: UV curing source (optional)
components.spec: Only if the lens is solidified; curing shrinkage and heating are separate, unmodelled processes

scope: Proposal for hardware that realizes the S07 numerical model; not a validated or built apparatus.
